subject: accountancy

concepts.title: New Profit Sharing Ratio
concepts.definition: The ratio in which all partners, including the new one, will share future profits of the firm.
concepts.key_idea: Old partners sacrifice a portion of their profit share to accommodate the incoming partner.
question_patterns: calculate the new profit sharing ratio
what will be the new profit sharing ratio
find the new ratio of all partners
determine the new profit sharing ratio

solution_steps.explain: Determine how much each old partner gives up.
Subtract sacrifice from old share.

concepts.title: Sacrificing Ratio
concepts.definition: The specific ratio in which existing partners surrender a portion of their profit share to the incoming partner.
concepts.key_idea: Compensation for loss of future profit share.
question_patterns: calculate the sacrificing ratio
find the sacrifice made by old partners
what is the sacrificing ratio
determine the ratio of sacrifice

solution_steps.action: Subtract new share from old share
solution_steps.explain: The difference represents the sacrifice.

concepts.title: Goodwill - Average Profits Method
concepts.definition: Valuing goodwill based on the average of past profits multiplied by an agreed number of years of expected future benefit.
concepts.key_idea: Past performance predicts future excess earnings.
question_patterns: calculate goodwill using average profits method
find the value of goodwill based on average profits
what is the goodwill value
compute goodwill

solution_steps.explain: Sum of profits divided by number of years.
Multiply average profit by purchase years.

concepts.title: Goodwill - Super Profits Method
concepts.definition: Valuing goodwill based on the excess of actual average profits over normal profits expected on capital employed.
concepts.key_idea: Goodwill represents earnings above the industry standard.
question_patterns: calculate goodwill using super profits method
find super profit and goodwill
determine goodwill value
how much is the goodwill

solution_steps.explain: Capital employed times normal rate of return.
Average profit minus normal profit.
Super profit times years purchase.

concepts.title: Goodwill - Capitalisation Method
concepts.definition: Determining goodwill by calculating the capital required to earn the average profit at the normal rate of return and subtracting the actual net assets.
concepts.key_idea: Goodwill is the excess of capitalised value over actual net assets.
question_patterns: calculate goodwill by capitalisation method
find goodwill using capitalisation of average profits
what is the goodwill value via capitalisation
compute goodwill capitalisation

solution_steps.explain: Average profit divided by normal rate.
Capitalised value minus net assets.

concepts.title: Change in Profit Sharing Ratio
concepts.definition: A situation where existing partners modify their mutual profit distribution agreement without any partner entering or leaving the firm.
concepts.key_idea: Reconstitution of the firm where some partners gain share at the expense of others.
question_patterns: what happens when partners change their profit sharing ratio
explain the impact of change in profit sharing ratio among existing partners
how is goodwill treated when profit sharing ratio changes
identify adjustments needed for change in PSR

solution_steps.explain: Identify the existing ratio and the newly agreed ratio for all partners.
Subtract the new share from the old share for each partner.
Debit gaining partners and credit sacrificing partners for their respective share of goodwill and accumulated profits.

concepts.title: Sacrificing Ratio
concepts.definition: The ratio in which existing partners surrender a portion of their profit share in favor of other partners or a new partner.
concepts.key_idea: The decrease in a partner's profit share due to firm reconstitution.
question_patterns: calculate the sacrificing ratio
find the share sacrificed by partner
determine the ratio of sacrifice between old partners

solution_steps.explain: Note the old_share and new_share of the partner.

concepts.title: Gaining Ratio
concepts.definition: The ratio representing the increase in profit share acquired by specific partners from other partners during reconstitution.
concepts.key_idea: The increase in a partner's profit share resulting from a change in the sharing agreement.
question_patterns: calculate the gaining ratio
find the share gained by the partner
who is the gaining partner in this ratio change
determine the gain of existing partners

solution_steps.explain: Note the new_share and old_share of the partner.

concepts.title: Goodwill Valuation - Average Profit Method
concepts.definition: A method to estimate goodwill by multiplying the average of past years' profits by a fixed number of years of purchase.
concepts.key_idea: Valuing the firm's reputation based on its historical earning capacity.
question_patterns: calculate goodwill at years purchase of average profits
find the value of goodwill using average profit method

solution_steps.explain: Add all the profits provided for the given years.
Divide total profit by the number of years.
Multiply the average profit by the number of years of purchase.

concepts.title: Revaluation of Assets and Liabilities
concepts.definition: The process of adjusting the book values of assets and liabilities to reflect their current market values at the time of firm reconstitution.
concepts.key_idea: Ensuring that gains or losses from value changes prior to reconstitution are shared in the old ratio.
question_patterns: prepare revaluation account
calculate profit or loss on revaluation

pass journal entries for increase in asset value

solution_steps.explain: Find the total increase in asset values.
Find the total decrease in asset values and increase in liabilities.
Subtract total decreases from total increases.

concepts.title: Treatment of Accumulated Reserves
concepts.definition: The transfer of undistributed profits or general reserves to the partners' capital accounts in their old profit-sharing ratio.
concepts.key_idea: Distributing past earnings to partners before the profit-sharing ratio changes.
question_patterns: how to treat general reserve on change in PSR
distribute accumulated profits among partners
pass entry for transfer of reserve fund
calculate partner's share in general reserve

solution_steps.explain: Locate the balance of reserves or accumulated profits in the balance sheet.
Multiply total reserves by the partner's old profit share.

concepts.title: New Profit Sharing Ratio - Remaining Share Method
concepts.definition: Calculating the new ratio by deducting the new partner's share from the total (1) and distributing the remainder among old partners.
concepts.key_idea: Determining future profit distribution when a new partner is admitted for a fixed share.
question_patterns: calculate new profit sharing ratio on admission
find the new ratio if C is admitted for 1/6 share
determine the new PSR of all partners

solution_steps.explain: Subtract the new partner's share from the total share of 1.
Multiply the remaining share by each old partner's individual old ratio.
